title: Educational Excellence and Strategic Promotion: Strengthening Islamic School Branding Through 7P Integration
core_idea: To investigate how the 7P marketing mix (product, price, place, promotion, people, process, physical evidence) can be applied strategically to enhance the branding of an Islamic school (Madrasah Tsanawiyah Darul Arifin), using a qualitative descriptive approach with interviews, observation, and documentation involving school leaders, staff, students, and community members.
tldr: A qualitative study exploring the application of the 7P marketing mix to strengthen an Islamic madrasah's branding and institutional visibility.
